text: On the commander-advocate's return: preferable to have the linter mirror the flightdeck one; node should work, it works on other branches. Dispatch units in rooms. Stage A pinned for removal in the workshop, but left. The schemas describe the intended shape: new files pass, old files fail but can be refitted easily because we have a schema we can make green. An advice file carries four fields (type, unit, context, stamp).
